content: image-minimizer-webpack-plugin (successor to deprecated imagemin-webpack-plugin) integrates with webpack's build pipeline to compress PNG/JPG/WebP at build time; vue-cli-service v4 (webpack 4) is compatible via chainWebpack config. For this project's scale (a handful of manually-placed screenshots in public/), a build-time plugin is likely unnecessary complexity; manual pre-compression (e.g. Squoosh.app, TinyPNG) before committing assets to public/img/projects/ is simpler and matches the existing 'assets already produced by user' workflow.
